title: Peter Thiel almost intercepted over energy technology

tellings.quote: I was I got a heads up from the the senior MOCI guy and I back channel that information to Eric Weinstein.

plain: On Jesse Michels's podcast, a guest named Steven Greer tells a story about the tech investor Peter Thiel nearly being intercepted over some kind of new energy technology in the United States. Greer says he got a warning from a senior insider and passed it quietly to Eric Weinstein, a researcher who knows Thiel. He tells it to suggest that people chasing breakthrough energy can be watched and stopped.
